messages:
emily_cs: FYI — Mediscan reached out asking to onboard their MedScan-v2 model into Redwood Private (VPC). Primary asks: PHI redaction, classification/regression evals on radiology images metadata, and a staging->prod timeline. They also want docs for SOC2/PII handling.
raj_cs: Thanks. Do we have their dataset size and can they provide a de-identified subset for evals?
emily_cs: They said ~120k labeled studies, can share a de-identified 2k subset after an NDA. Requesting a 3-week onboarding window from staging to prod.
jon_ml: For a model like MedScan-v2 (image + report text), we'll need model artifact (onnx/torchscript) and a sample run script. We'll prefer a TorchScript export for Private. Latency targets? batch vs single-image throughput?
karen_safety: Important: PHI redaction must run pre-inference on the text fields. Also need post-hoc leakage checks. We'll require a redaction pipeline that conforms to our PII rules: names, MRNs, DOB, addresses, free-text PHI. Add automated tests for redaction coverage.
emily_cs: Noted. Customer wants real-time inference (p95 latency < 350ms) for single-image queries, but can accept higher if we suggest a dedicated pool. They're on a renewal in 5 months — high commercial risk if onboarding stalls.
raj_cs: Action items: 1) ML to propose eval plan + resource estimate 2) Security to list PHI controls + required artifacts 3) CS to schedule enablement + NDA followup. ETA EOD tomorrow for a first pass?
jon_ml: I'll draft an eval harness. Quick prototype command for our infra:
```
# run eval harness
python eval_harness.py \
  --model /tmp/medscan_v2_ts.pt \
  --images /data/medscan/deid_2k/ \
  --metrics auc,precision,recall,latency \
  --batch-size 1 --warmup 50
```
jon_ml: Also propose quantized fp16 runtime for Dedicated; if Private VPC wants max perf we can recommend int8 quant with perf/regression caveats.
karen_safety: We'll need the sample de-id data before running leakage tests. Provide the redaction rules doc link and a template for the test set labeling.
emily_cs: I'll request the NDA and the de-id export today. Also scheduling a 1hr enablement session next Tue — invite Mediscan + eng + security. Can someone create the ticket?
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-3421 "Mediscan MedScan-v2 Private onboarding - PHI redaction & eval" assigned to @jon_ml, due 2026-02-12.
raj_cs: Great. jon, can you include an estimate for Dedicated GPU-hours and a canary rollout plan in the ticket?
jon_ml: Will do — adding perf matrix + canary steps. quick note: if images require extra preprocess (DICOM -> PNG) call that out so we avoid surprises.
emily_cs: Perfect. I'll update the customer and attach the NDA template. :white_check_mark:
raj_cs: Thanks team. Keeping this high priority because of renewal window. :eyes:
